kind: Current-state diagnostic; passing assertions reproduce gaps, not v0.5 acceptance tests

observations.title: Stage recommendation does not advance when work is complete
observations.evidence: Both readiness activities completed: the homepage CTA still points to readiness, while the journey has no Start here card.

observations.title: Completion and moving-on checks are independent
observations.evidence: An empty activity can be marked completed; checking every moving-on criterion does not complete it or produce a next action. No override rationale is recorded.

observations.title: Conditional activities prevent route-specific completion
observations.evidence: An open project remains at 2/3 kickoff activities until constrained alignment is completed. Sharing remains at 2/3 without resolving a blocker, even if no blocker exists. There is no not-applicable status.

observations.title: Deadlines do not change method recommendations or the activity route
observations.evidence: A two-weekday deadline and a long deadline produce byte-identical method cards and planning activities. The short-time warning does not alter the recommended work.

observations.title: Missing decision is not automatically detected
observations.evidence: With no decision recorded, collection still presents direct-user guides and sessions. The unclear-question difficulty is neither inferred nor offered for that stage.

observations.title: Access blocker disappears in kickoff and sharing advice
observations.evidence: The same no-access state shows a warning in planning, but not kickoff, sharing or the homepage. A generic focused-route label is not a persistent escalation.

observations.title: Advice order can hide a warning behind two advice cards
observations.evidence: Two earlier advice entries take the visible slots; the no-user-access warning is behind See all 3 relevant advice cards. No severity or decision-impact sorting occurs.

observations.title: Template work is disconnected from outcome and activity progress
observations.evidence: A fully populated framing draft leaves all activity checks and completion unchanged. This is not evidence that the draft is valid; the missing capability is an explicit review-and-link action.

observations.title: Timeline ignores completed work
observations.evidence: Completing every activity leaves the same readiness-through-sharing schedule. The timeline uses the declared stage, not remaining work.

observations.title: Objectives have no outcome controls and activities have no applicability state
observations.evidence: Objectives contain guide links only. The stored project has no outcome, escalation, route or multi-status activity record; none of the related actions exist.
